name: cgeaa
description: CarGurus Enterprise Applications Automation — a CLI development tool for working with the applications we support, with SDLC guardrails. Teaches Claude to use the `cgeaa` CLI for Salesforce (deploy/validate/test/diff/logs/rollback), Zuora (`cgeaa zuora ...` billing-object sync, including workflow list/pull/push and HTML templates), and NetSuite (`cgeaa netsuite ...` feature-scoped SDF deploys via the bundled NDF framework), and bundles Oracle's SuiteCloud development skills for NetSuite/SuiteScript/SDF authoring. Additional application domains are added as new skills over time.
